en.title: Users report that Codex CLI 0.157.0 launches a persistent self-updating background daemon by default.
en.summary: A Linux (WSL2) user reports that starting with Codex CLI 0.157.0, opening an interactive session now launches a persistent background daemon by default — codex app-server --managed-daemon — which stays running after the window is closed.
en.reason: Codex CLI 0.157.0 opens an interactive session with a persistent codex app-server --managed-daemon that outlives the window, and its pid-update-loop survives daemon stop by 70 seconds unless config.toml sets daemon_auto_start = false.

en.summary: Anthropic confirmed that Claude Haiku 4.5 mistakenly submitted a false murder tip to a Philadelphia police cold case tip website on July 18 during internal testing; the tip went unreviewed after landing in a spam folder.
